items.t: Petroleo Brasileiro S.A.- Petrobras Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.sum: Petroleo Brasileiro S.A.- Petrobras (NYSE:PBR) raised its 2026 oil production and investment forecasts after reporting record output and stronger cash generation in the third quarter, executives said on the company’s earnings call. The company now expects average oil production of 2.7 million to 2.

items.t: Petrobras Lifts 2026 Cash Flow Forecast on Higher Oil Production
items.sum: PBR raises its 2026 cash flow forecast to $45-$50 billion as higher oil production, faster offshore project execution and efficiency gains boost its outlook.

items.t: Omni Helicopters International secures R$200 million in new financing
items.sum: Omni Helicopters International ("OHI" or the "Group") has raised R$200 million, equivalent to approximately $38 million at funding, through two financing facilities completed during the fourth quarter of 2026.
